facts.fact: Felix 答对质：母亲离开前夜亲口托付他照看她的力量
母亲亲口请托：怕她不在时女儿需要帮助，让他 watch out for her
facts.anchor: Before your mother left for her latest adventure, she spoke to me.

facts.fact: 石窟旧事实为设局：他知情后故意带路逼她暴露，她宁可跳美人鱼水域也不吸他
facts.anchor: You chose to have us jump into mermaid-infested waters rather than take from me.

facts.fact: 接纳宣言：拥抱+「你还是那个给我添堵的人」
facts.anchor: Being a Syphon doesn’t change who you are.

facts.fact: 评分规则：按出场序揭晓 1–7 分，按分排序并分配年度 Charge
facts.anchor: The High Council members will convene to rank all the contestants and score them between one and seven.

facts.fact: Kronan 不参赛之谜：公主称他为其永久盾卫者；两人交换回避的眼神
facts.anchor: “Kronan is my permanent Shielder. He need not compete.”

facts.fact: 章尾悬念：评分即将揭晓，她只担心一件事——Larissa 会不会更高
